modules.description: Top-level container for module configurations; used to enable/disable ejabberd_mod_s2s_log and set its parameters

ejabberd_mod_s2s_log.description: Configuration block for the S2S connection logging module

enabled.description: Set to true to enable logging of server-to-server XMPP connections

filters.description: Optional list of filter rules to selectively log S2S events

description.description: Explanation of what the filter does

enabled.description: Whether this filter rule is active

name.description: Descriptive name for the filter (shown in comments)

format.description: Log entry format: 'text' for human-readable logs, 'json' for structured logging compatible with log aggregators

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file where S2S connection events will be written

log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0=none, 1=errors only, 2=errors+info (recommended), 3=debug (verbose, may impact performance)

max_days.description: Maximum number of days to retain log files before automatic cleanup (use 0 to disable age-based rotation)

max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per log file before it is rotated (e.g., 10485760 = 10 MB)
